notes: Florence is walkable (the centre is a ZTL, closed to cars). Take the bus (SITA) to Siena and San Gimignano; for Chianti, use a car or a tour. Tram T2 runs to the airport.
Uffizi, Accademia, dome: buy timed tickets online weeks ahead. The first Sunday is free (and crowded). Firenze Card costs 85 EUR for 72 hours.
November to February is quiet and 8–12°C. There are no museum queues, December brings the Christmas market, and November is olive oil harvest in Chianti.
Lampredotto 5 EUR, schiacciata 8 EUR, trattoria 20–30 EUR, bistecca 50–60 EUR/kg. Coperto (cover charge) 2–3 EUR, coffee at the bar 1.30 EUR.
Tap water is safe to drink. Cover shoulders and knees in the Duomo and churches.
The Vasari Corridor has reopened (reserve through the Uffizi).

stops.name: Cattedrale di Santa Maria del Fiore
stops.tips: Entry to the cathedral is free (expect a queue). The Brunelleschi Pass (30 EUR) covers the dome, bell tower, baptistery and museum.

stops.name: Brunelleschi's Dome Climb
stops.tips: 463 steps. Book a timed slot weeks ahead. You climb past the frescoes to a view over the city.

stops.name: Battistero di San Giovanni
stops.tips: Ghiberti's Gates of Paradise (copy) and the mosaic ceiling. Included in the pass.

stops.name: Mercato Centrale Firenze
stops.tips: Market on the ground floor, food hall upstairs. Try lampredotto (tripe sandwich) at Nerbone and a truffle sandwich.

stops.name: Piazza della Signoria
stops.tips: An open-air sculpture museum: Loggia dei Lanzi, the Neptune Fountain and a copy of David.

backups.name: All'Antico Vinaio
backups.tips: Schiacciata sandwiches with a queue out the door. On Via dei Neri.

backups.name: Museo dell'Opera del Duomo
backups.tips: The original Gates of Paradise and Michelangelo's Pietà. Included in the pass.

stops.name: Galleria degli Uffizi
stops.tips: Botticelli's Venus, Leonardo, Caravaggio. Take the 08:15 first slot, book online (29 EUR) and allow 2.5 hours.

stops.name: Ponte Vecchio
stops.tips: The bridge of the goldsmiths, with the Vasari Corridor running above.

stops.name: Trattoria Sergio Gozzi
stops.tips: A local trattoria in San Lorenzo since 1915. Ribollita (Tuscan bread soup) and bistecca at lunch.

stops.name: Basilica di San Lorenzo & Medici Chapels
stops.tips: Michelangelo's sculptures in the New Sacristy, and the Medici tombs.

stops.name: Piazzale Michelangelo
stops.tips: The postcard view of the city at sunset. The church of San Miniato is 10 minutes further up (Gregorian chant at 17:30).

backups.name: Trattoria Mario
backups.tips: Lunch at shared tables opposite the market. Cash only.

backups.name: Palazzo Vecchio
backups.tips: The town hall and the Salone dei Cinquecento, with views from the tower.

stops.name: Galleria dell'Accademia
stops.tips: Michelangelo's David and the Prisoners. Book the 08:15 slot online.

stops.name: Museo di San Marco
stops.tips: Monastic cells frescoed by Fra Angelico. Quiet.

stops.name: Mercato di Sant'Ambrogio
stops.tips: A local market, with Cibrèo café and Trattoria da Rocco (inside the market).

stops.name: Basilica of Santa Croce
stops.tips: Tombs of Michelangelo, Galileo and Machiavelli, plus Giotto's frescoes.

stops.name: Scuola del Cuoio
stops.tips: A leather school behind Santa Croce. Watch the craftsmen at work.

backups.name: Museo Galileo
backups.tips: Scientific instruments. An alternative to Santa Croce.

stops.name: Palazzo Pitti Galleria Palatina
stops.tips: The Medici palace, with Raphael and Titian. A combined ticket with the Uffizi costs 40 EUR.

stops.name: Boboli Gardens
stops.tips: A Renaissance garden. See the Neptune pool and cross over to Bardini.

stops.name: Giardino Bardini
stops.tips: Included with the Boboli ticket. Look for the wisteria tunnel (April to May) and the view of the Duomo.

stops.name: Gustapizza Oltrarno
stops.tips: Neapolitan-style pizza near Santo Spirito. Expect a queue.

stops.name: Piazza Santo Spirito
stops.tips: The square of the artisans' quarter, with Brunelleschi's church and workshops (Via Maggio). Come for aperitivo in the evening.

backups.name: Brancacci Chapel
backups.tips: Masaccio's frescoes in Santa Maria del Carmine. Reserve.

stops.name: Piazza del Campo Siena
stops.tips: 1.5 hours by bus. A shell-shaped square, home to the Palio (2 July to 16 August).

stops.name: Siena Cathedral
stops.tips: A black-and-white striped cathedral with the Piccolomini Library and a marble floor (uncovered August to October).

stops.name: Torre del Mangia
stops.tips: A 400-step tower with views over the Campo.

stops.name: Osteria Le Logge Siena
stops.tips: Tuscan cooking next to the Campo. Try the pici pasta.

stops.name: San Gimignano Towers
stops.tips: The medieval Manhattan, with 14 towers. Stop at Gelateria Dondoli (world champion ice cream) and walk the walls at sunset.

backups.name: Monteriggioni
backups.tips: A village with circular walls. A closer alternative to San Gimignano.

stops.name: Greve in Chianti
stops.tips: The capital of Chianti, with a triangular square and Antica Macelleria Falorni.

stops.name: Castello di Verrazzano Wine Tour
stops.tips: A tour of the castle's vineyard with tasting. Reserve; go by tour or car.

stops.name: Castello di Verrazzano Lunch
stops.tips: Tuscan lunch at the vineyard, served with wine.

stops.name: Panzano in Chianti
stops.tips: Dario Cecchini's butcher village, home to the poet-butcher.

stops.name: Castellina in Chianti
stops.tips: An Etruscan tunnel and the town walls, with vineyards at sunset.

backups.name: Badia a Passignano
backups.tips: An abbey and the Antinori vineyards. An alternative to Verrazzano.

days.theme: Santa Maria Novella: a light farewell

stops.name: Basilica di Santa Maria Novella
stops.tips: Masaccio's Trinity, next to the station.

stops.name: Officina Profumo-Farmaceutica di Santa Maria Novella
stops.tips: A pharmacy and perfumery since 1221. Good for gifts.

stops.name: Trattoria Sostanza
stops.tips: Famous for its butter chicken breast since 1869. Cash only, lunch.

stops.name: Firenze Santa Maria Novella Station
stops.tips: Pisa is 1 hour away and Rome 1.5 hours. Tram T2 to the airport takes 20 minutes. Time to say goodbye.

backups.name: Museo Novecento
backups.tips: 20th-century art. An alternative to the basilica.
